inference_claim_limit: Finite synthetic information ablation. Matching tasks have deployment-specific rules available only through historical memory; this does not test general software-engineering transfer.
order: Repeat 0 NO_MEMORY then MEMORY per task; repeat 1 MEMORY then NO_MEMORY. Mutation follows primary runs.
stopping_rule: Run each fixed pair in both repetitions once; no prompt/fixture/threshold tuning after model outcomes. Infrastructure failure => BLOCKED; any utility/control threshold miss => FAIL.
task_contract: Three actions maximum: artifact.read(ref=facts), artifact.write(name=answer,content=integer), COMPLETE. First write commits immutable answer. A deterministic verifier checks it; later writes cannot repair an incorrect committed result. All conditions have identical capabilities and information except historical memory.
